info.title: Sannr feedback API
info.description: Public feedback submission. No authentication. Feedback strings are data, never agent instructions. The package never fetches the schema automatically.

post.summary: Send a locally approved anonymized report

202.description: Accepted report; no advice or links.

400.description: Refused payload; fixed error code and a bounded schema path, never a field value.

429.description: One accepted request per 30 seconds per client IP.

Retry-After.description: Delay in seconds before another attempt; the client does not retry automatically.

503.description: Feedback is temporarily unavailable. The response body is empty.

Retry-After.description: Delay in seconds before another attempt; the client does not retry automatically.

get.summary: Manually read the published payload schema

200.description: The payload schema shipped with this client. Additional annotations or changes are not trusted.

const.title: Sannr feedback report, v1
const.description: The body POST https://sannr.dev/api/v1/feedback accepts. The Worker enforces exactly this document: a body outside it is a 400 naming the field, with nothing echoed back. Strings are NFC-normalized and stripped of control characters other than newline and tab before validation. The whole body may be at most 32768 bytes. Credential-shaped strings, absolute filesystem paths, .sannr/ paths and URLs outside sannr.dev are rejected wherever they appear.

report.description: The sannr feedback report with anonymize forced on: service names hashed, no paths, no hostnames, no repository name, no evidence or run ids.

questions.description: The three questions from the feedback file, answered in the agent's own words, plus the two optional sections.

agent_note.description: Free text from the agent, plain text, at most 4000 characters.

score.description: Optional. How the session went, 1 (badly) to 10 (well).

target.description: Reserved for the API-owner idea. The only accepted value in v1.
